item.title: Guinean wrestler Ndoc qualifies for world championship round
item.description: Wotna Cana Ndoc will face Russian Ibragim Ibragimov in a qualification match for the round of 32.

item.title: Firkidja di Pubis denounces regime crisis
item.description: Political movement calls for international sanctions against coup leaders and return to democracy.

item.title: Guinea-Bissau minister urges realistic budgets
item.description: Communication Minister Abduramane Turé called for financial capacity assessment before state commitments.

item.title: PSTGB leader criticises ECOWAS, demands elections
item.description: Sene Bacai Cassamá says ECOWAS consultations excluded parties and calls for simultaneous polls within six months.
